## Style rules
- No comments in code

## Task 1: Create `convention-plugin-multiplatform/` directory

### File: `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/convention-plugin-multiplatform/settings.gradle.kts`
```kotlin
rootProject.name = "convention-plugin-multiplatform"
```

### File: `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/convention-plugin-multiplatform/build.gradle.kts`
```kotlin
plugins {
    `kotlin-dsl`
}

dependencies {
    implementation(libs.android.tools.gradle)
    implementation(libs.jetbrains.compose.plugin)
    implementation(libs.kotlin.gradle.plugin)
    implementation(libs.jetbrains.compose.compiler.plugin)
    implementation(files(libs.javaClass.superclass.protectionDomain.codeSource.location))
}
```

### File: `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/convention-plugin-multiplatform/src/main/kotlin/composeMultiplatformConvention.gradle.kts`

This is the KEY convention plugin that all KMP library modules will use. It sets up all targets and shared dependencies. Read the local example FIRST at `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/.claude/skills/kmp-expert/examples/convention-plugin-multiplatform/composeMultiplatformConvention.gradle.kts` and use it EXACTLY as-is (it already has the correct content for this project).

## Task 2: Convert `shared-dto` to KMP

The current `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/shared-dto/build.gradle.kts` uses `kotlin.jvm` only. Replace it with KMP:

### File: `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/shared-dto/build.gradle.kts` (OVERWRITE)
```kotlin
plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.multiplatform)
    alias(libs.plugins.kotlinx.serialization)
}

group = "com.bookreads"

kotlin {
    jvm()
    js { browser() }
    wasmJs { browser() }
    iosArm64()
    iosSimulatorArm64()

    sourceSets {
        commonMain.dependencies {
            implementation(libs.kotlinx.serialization.json)
        }
    }
}
```

Move the DTO source files to `commonMain`. Read the current DTO files from `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/shared-dto/src/main/kotlin/com/bookreads/dto/` and write them to `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/shared-dto/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/bookreads/dto/` with identical content.

### File: `/Users/se/git/cc-experiments/build.gradle.kts` (OVERWRITE)

Add `alias(libs.plugins.android.application) apply false` to the plugins block. Read the current file first, then add the new plugin line. The final content should be:
